question: ______ is the process of allowing particles in suspension in water to settle out of the suspension under the effect of gravity.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sedimentation**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__**Sedimentation is the process of allowing particles in suspension in water to settle out of the suspension under the effect of gravity**__.

__
 
• When the heavier component in a mixture settles after water is added to it, the process is called sedimentation.
 
• Under the Sedimentation process, all of the solids settle to the bottom of the beaker, leaving a clear layer of liquid on top.
 
• Sedimentation is a filtering procedure used in water treatment plants to remove undesirable particles from dirty water.
 
• Sedimentation also helps to determine the medical conditions of a person.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Decantation** is the separation process in which two immiscible liquids are separated.

 
 
• When the water (along with the dust) is removed, the process is called decantation.
 
• Decantation is the process of separating a mixture of oil and water.
 
 
 
• **Filtration** can be used to separate components of a mixture of an insoluble solid and a liquid.
 
• The selective boiling and subsequent condensation of a component in a liquid combination are referred to as **distillation.**
